Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From 97dc5bf8d60938741e2f99242dff3684c29b6d90 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2015 12:29:31 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] phy: sun9i-usb: add USB dependency

The sun9i usb phy driver calls of_usb_get_phy_mode(), which is not
available if USB is disabled:

drivers/built-in.o: In function `sun9i_usb_phy_probe':
:(.text+0x7fb0): undefined reference to `of_usb_get_phy_mode'

This adds a dependency to avoid the randconfig build errors.

Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Fixes: 9c3b44302636 ("phy: Add driver to support individual USB PHYs on sun9i")
Acked-by: Chen-Yu Tsai <wens@csie.org>
Signed-off-by: Kishon Vijay Abraham I <kishon@ti.com>

diff --git a/drivers/phy/Kconfig b/drivers/phy/Kconfig
index 7eb5859dd035..03cb3ea2d2c0 100644
--- a/drivers/phy/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/phy/Kconfig
@@ -233,6 +233,7 @@ config PHY_SUN9I_USB
 	tristate "Allwinner sun9i SoC USB PHY driver"
 	depends on ARCH_SUNXI && HAS_IOMEM && OF
 	depends on RESET_CONTROLLER
+	depends on USB_COMMON
 	select GENERIC_PHY
 	help
 	  Enable this to support the transceiver that is part of Allwinner
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/phy/Kconfig`**
   - A new dependency was added to the configuration for the Allwinner sun9i SoC USB PHY driver (`PHY_SUN9I_USB`):
     - `depends on USB_COMMON`
   - This change ensures that the driver will only be built if USB support is enabled, preventing build errors related to undefined references when USB is disabled.

### Relationships
- The modification in the `Kconfig` file establishes a direct relationship between the sun9i USB PHY driver and the USB subsystem. By adding the `depends on USB_COMMON` line, the patch addresses a specific build issue where the function `of_usb_get_phy_mode()` was not available when USB support was disabled. This dependency ensures that the driver can only be compiled in environments where USB functionality is present, thus avoiding potential runtime errors and undefined references during the build process.

phy: sun9i-usb: add USB dependency

The sun9i usb phy driver calls of_usb_get_phy_mode(), which is not

drivers/built-in.o: In function `sun9i_usb_phy_probe':
:(.text+0x7fb0): undefined reference to `of_usb_get_phy_mode'

This adds a dependency to avoid the randconfig build errors.

Signed-off-by: Arnd Bergmann <arnd@arndb.de>
Fixes: 9c3b44302636 ("phy: Add driver to support individual USB PHYs on sun9i")
Acked-by: Chen-Yu Tsai <wens@csie.org>

Here is the root cause:
The sun9i USB PHY driver calls the function `of_usb_get_phy_mode()`, which is not defined when USB support is disabled, leading to undefined reference errors during the build process. This occurs because the driver does not have a proper dependency on the USB subsystem, allowing it to be compiled even when USB functionality is not available.
